description: Explores Tolkien’s invented languages, fictional translation, material remnants, and differing experiences of time to explain Middle-earth’s historical depth. Examines Westron, Quenya and Sindarin, ruins and songs, the moral costs of preserving a fading world, and the manuscript revisions behind the apparent consistency of its history.
